description: Paid endpoint ($0.005): hourly funding settlements for one Hyperliquid perp (rate hourly/8h/annualized, premium) plus mean/min/max, positive/negative hours and cumulative rate. Give hours (1-720, default 168) or from/to (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 UTC, max 720 hours). History back to each perp's listing (BTC since 2023-05-12). Bad params or unknown symbol return an error and no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL. Free sample response: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/funding-history

hours.description: Last N hours (default 168). Do not combine with from/to.

to.description: End, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive) or ISO 8601 UTC; default now

name: get_funding_history
title: Funding history (paid, x402)
